title: PostgreSQL MVCC tuple invisibility during vacuum freeze transaction ID wraparound
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0587: PostgreSQL MVCC tuple invisibility during vacuum freeze transaction ID wraparound
Repository: `postgres/postgres`
Category: `Storage Engine Crash Consistency & WAL`
Target File: `src/backend/access/transam/varsup.c`

#### Problem Description
Transaction ID comparison macro treats ancient frozen tuple as future transaction after 2^31 epoch wrap.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Enforce vacuum freeze threshold and verify TransactionIdPrecedes handles modular epoch arithmetic.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0587.py -q`
expected_invariant: Enforce vacuum freeze threshold and verify TransactionIdPrecedes handles modular epoch arithmetic.
